findings.text: addToLocal skips any flag whose name is in parentsPflags. A child's own flag that shadows a parent persistent flag (for example local `--verbose` and parent persistent `--verbose`) is therefore left out of LocalFlags(). It disappears from help output and from NonInheritedFlags. The old code snapshotted the child's flags before merging in the parent's.

The root no longer merges flag.CommandLine (the pflag global set, e.g. flags added through AddGoFlagSet) into its persistent flags. LocalFlags() also dropped the CommandLine merge for the root. Flags registered on the global set are no longer available or parsed, so passing one of them fails with 'unknown flag'.

LocalFlags() and InheritedFlags() now return the shared cached c.lflags and c.iflags instead of fresh sets. Callers that mutate the result, or that rely on flags being removed or changed later, see stale or polluted state. These caches are only ever added to, never rebuilt.

1.reason: The patch deletes both flag.CommandLine merges (root persistent flags in mergePersistentFlags and the root LocalFlags merge) and adds no replacement, so flags registered on pflag's global CommandLine are no longer added to the command's flags or parsed.

2.reason: pflag FlagSets don't support removing flags, and the cached sets are re-checked against the updated parentsPflags/local sets on every call, so returning the cached lflags/iflags is an intended design choice (upstream cobra does the same), not a confirmed defect.
